headline: Cemetery 2026 budget, Civil War Monument work, and lawn care contract.
summary: Cemetery finances and grant searches for the Civil War Monument in West Cemetery are on the agenda. Gravestone records for North Cemetery, including QR codes, and a December wreath event are also listed.
items: Lawn care contract update and discussion, to be done by the City of Bristol Parks Department
Update on the Civil War Monument in West Cemetery
Looking for grants to finish the Civil War Monument
North Cemetery gravestone location paperwork, being corrected to post online with QR codes and other collected information
Adding QR codes to selected stones discussion
Wreaths Across America on December 19, 2026, at noon, at Lewis Street Cemetery
location: Bristol Historical Society, 98 Summer Street, Bristol, CT 06010

Street Cemetery.
